title: We found 4,972 "hello" messages hiding thousands of malicious commands targeting Flowise
description: The Greeter attack framework targets Flowise, an AI development platform, by exploiting a vulnerability (CVE-2024-58351) in its runtime configuration mechanism. Attackers send numerous benign-looking "hello" messages that carry malicious JavaScript commands via the overrideConfig parameter, enabling remote code execution without altering the saved chatflow. This allows attackers to perform host reconnaissance, credential and cloud metadata harvesting, persistence attempts, and fileless execution preparation. The attack was observed on exposed Flowise instances, including unauthenticated and vulnerable deployments, highlighting risks of AI applications as entry points into cloud environments.
